verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜ ਤਤੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰਿ ਜਗਤ ਉਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: pa(n)j tat paravaan kar khaanee chaar jagat upaiaa|

en.bdb: Mixing the five elements from four (life) mines (egg, foetus, sweat, vegetation) the whole world was created.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀ ਜੂਨਿ ਵਿਚ ਆਵਾਗਵਣ ਚਲਤੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: lakh chauraasee joon vich aavaagavan chalat varataiaa|

en.bdb: Creating the eighty-four lakhs speicies of life, the feat of transmigration has been accomplished in them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸ ਇਕਸ ਜੂਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਅਣਗਣਤ ਵਧਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: eikas ikas joon vich jeea ja(n)t anaganat vadhaiaa|

en.bdb: In each one of the species many a creature has been produced.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੇਖੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: lekhai a(n)dhar sabh ko sabhanaa masatak lekh likhaiaa|

en.bdb: All are responsible (for their actions) and carry writ of fate on their forehead.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੇਖੈ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ਦੇ ਲੇਖ ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: lekhai saas giraas dhe lekh likhaaree a(n)t na paiaa|

en.bdb: Every breath and morsel is counted. Mystery of writs and that Writer could not be known by any one.
Himself imperceptible, He is beyond all writs.
